name: sh101
summary: Roland SH-101-style 4-pole (24 dB/oct) resonant lowpass: an IR3109-style ladder of four one-pole OTA stages with a soft-clipped negative feedback (so it self-oscillates cleanly at high resonance) and the SH-101's output-level resonance compensation. Character references: Mutable Instruments Ripples / Audible Instruments Liquid Filter, and LFO-lab's SH-010. `f` (Q16) is the per-stage one-pole coefficient (≈ 2*sin(pi*fc/fs), 0..65535); `res` (Q16, 0..65535) is the resonance; `comp` (Q15) is the SH-101 output boost as resonance rises; `on` 0 = bypass. `k`/`vk` (Q15) push `f` toward 0/65535 (key/velocity follow), and `fenv` (control) scales `fenv_depth` (Q16) into the cutoff. Outputs: `out` (4-pole LP), `lp2` (2-pole LP), `band` (2-pole BP tap).
